Evening Course: Introduction to Web Design

This ten-week course runs on Wednesday evenings from 6:30pm to 8:30pm at the City College campus, starting on 16 January.

The fee is 240 pounds, with a reduced fee of 120 pounds for students and people receiving benefits.

No previous experience is needed, but students must bring their own laptop.
